# Opening files

A :jargon[buffer] holds text. Press :kbd[C-x C-f] to open a file, or
:try[C-x C-f] to watch it happen. `C-x C-s` saves.

![The screen](assets/screen.svg)

:::vscode
Ctrl+P is the closest thing.
:::

:::aside{title="Why C-x?"}
History.
:::

```elisp
;; :kbd[not a key] inside a code block is not checked
```
